enAjustes.texto: A short walk through Brecha's screens: the board, an application's page, the Inbox, your network and these settings.

bienvenida.texto: Brecha helps you keep track of your job applications: where you applied, where each one stands and what they answered. Everything is saved on your computer; only what you connect, like Gmail or OpenAI, goes out. It takes 8 short steps.

tablero.texto: Each column is a status: Undecided, To apply, Applied, In process, Interview and Offer. Drag a card to another column to change its status; with the keyboard, focus it and press M. If the status needs something, like the date you applied, you will be asked.

nueva.texto: With “New application” you save a job post you care about: role, company, link and platform. It starts as “Undecided” and you move it from there.

ficha.texto: Click a card to open its page. Its whole story is there: the signals that arrived (emails and replies from the company), your notes, the people you talked to and the interviews.

bandeja.texto: When you connect your email, the AI reads messages from companies and suggests which application each one belongs to. What it cannot match with confidence waits here for you to confirm, match or discard.

red.texto: Keep track here of the people you talk to on LinkedIn: requests, messages and which application they relate to. LinkedIn notifications that reach your email are added on their own.

ajustes.texto: Connect your Gmail (with an app password) and your OpenAI key here so the AI can read your emails. Brecha works without them too, but you enter everything by hand.

importar.texto: If you were already tracking your applications somewhere else, import them so you do not start from scratch. You can take this tour again anytime from Settings or by searching “tour” in the bar at the top.

ajustes.resumen: Your credentials, the language and how often your email is checked.
ajustes.guardada: Tested and saved in your system keychain.

correo.explicacion: Brecha reads your Gmail read-only to find replies to your applications. Gmail does not let other apps sign in with your normal password: Brecha uses an app password, only for Brecha, that you can delete any time.
correo.borrarTexto: The watcher stops checking your email until you save another one.

gmail.queHace: I'll guide you through 4 steps to create a Google app password (about 3 minutes).

paso1.texto: Google only lets you create app passwords if your account has 2-Step Verification. Open it with the account you want to connect and turn it on (with your phone). If you already have it, continue.

paso2.texto: Sign in with the same Gmail account you want to connect. If you have several accounts open, check the top right corner shows the right one.
paso2.noAparece: Does Google say the setting is not available? Go back to step 1: 2-Step Verification is missing. Work or school accounts may have it blocked by their administrator.

paso3.nombre: Type «Brecha» as the app name and press Create.
paso3.copiar: Google shows you 16 letters in a box: copy them.
paso3.unaVez: They are shown only once. If you lose them, delete it there and create another.

paso4.texto: Type your Gmail address and paste the 16 letters. Brecha tests them with Gmail before saving them in your system keychain; they are never shown again or written to files or logs.

siFalla.copiar: Check you copied all 16 letters (spaces do not matter).
siFalla.cuenta: The address must be the one of the account where you created the password.
siFalla.dosPasos: If you turned off 2-Step Verification, Google deletes app passwords: create a new one.
siFalla.trabajo: Work or school accounts may not allow app passwords.

openai.explicacion: The key is used to classify emails, analyse postings and answer in Ask. It is tested before saving and never shown again.
openai.borrarTexto: Without a key, emails are not classified and questions are not answered: emails stay queued.

ajustes.vigia: The watcher checks your email every
ajustes.vigiaSinDato: no data (the AI service is not responding)
ajustes.vigiaAyuda: It is changed in the AI service configuration.

csv.intro: Bring in your applications and LinkedIn contacts from a spreadsheet, or hand yours to someone else to import into their Brecha. Importing the same file twice leaves everything as it was.
csv.orden: Import applications first and contacts second, so each contact is linked to its application.
csv.formato: UTF-8, comma separated, with a header row. The type is recognized from the header.
csv.avisosEnProceso: The job posts for these applications are being added to Job posts to compute your fit.
csv.exportarTexto: Download all your applications or contacts in the same format used to import.
csv.plantillasTexto: The header row plus two made-up example rows, to fill in your spreadsheet.

stack.sinPerfil: Load your profile in Settings to see which tools you are missing.
stack.porAnalizar: Not compared with your profile yet: it shows up in a few minutes.

arriendos.canalesAyuda: Portals, messaging, email, phone and agencies. With their domains, Brecha recognizes each one's URLs and emails.
arriendos.busquedaAyuda: Hard rules rule a property out; soft rules rank it, and P1 weighs more than P2. Your AI reads them before searching and asks before changing them.
arriendos.motivoCambio: Why are you changing your rules?
arriendos.sinHistorial: You haven't changed your search yet.

criterios.aval: If they ask for a guarantor, I have one

importarArriendo.ayuda: Paste a listing, an email or a list, or upload a WhatsApp chat export. The AI suggests properties and you choose which to save. Phone numbers are never sent to the AI.
importarArriendo.comoExportar: In WhatsApp: open the chat → menu → More → Export chat → Without media. Upload the .txt (unzip it if it comes as .zip).

importarArriendo.recortado: the text was long: I used the most recent part

importarArriendo.algunasFallaron: Some couldn't be added: check them

preguntarArriendo.ayuda: Ask about the properties you follow: which one fits, which match your budget, who you owe a reply.
preguntarArriendo.ejemplo: Which ones meet all my rules and have a viewing this week?
